Mark-10 Wire Crimp Pull Tester Model WT3-201M
Discontinued April 2025- Replaced with WT3-205M
Capacity: 200 lbf
 Category: Obsolete Tags: 000 point data memory, 2, 200 lbf capacity, Mark-10, Motorized terminal tester, peak force value, real-time value, WT3-201M
Product Description & Resources
 Description 
Description
The WT3-201M motorized wire crimp pull tester is designed to measure pull-off forces of up to 200 lbF [1 kN] for wire and tube terminations. The tester conforms to numerous UL, ISO, ASTM, SAE, MIL, and other requirements for destructive testing. Non-destructive testing is also possible, such as pulling to a load or maintaining a load for a specified period of time, as per the requirements of UL 486A/B. Programmable pass/fail limits with red and green indicators and audio alerts help identify non-conforming samples.
The tester accommodates most insulation types and wire sizes up to AWG 3 (0.25 in [6.3 mm] OD). Samples can be sent to Mark-10 for evaluation prior to purchase. Auto-start automatically begins the test when the wire sample has been loaded. When the sample breaks, the tester can auto-reverse, output the peak force, store the peak force, and zero the display automatically, thereby increasing testing throughput. Further testing efficiency is achieved via the available Profiles function, through which multiple test setups may be saved and recalled as required.
On-board data storage and statistical calculations is provided for up to 2,000 readings, with available date and time stamp for each saved data point. Data can be transferred to a PC or other data collector via USB, RS-232, Mitutoyo (Digimatic), or analog outputs.
The WT3-201M includes MESUR™ Lite data acquisition software. MESUR™ Lite tabulates continuous or single point data. One-click export to Excel allows for further data manipulation.
Features
Measures real-time and peak force values
Selectable test speed with high-speed approach and reverse
Auto-start upon sample insertion
Auto-reverse at sample break or load
USB, RS-232, Mitutoyo (Digimatic), and analog outputs
Automatic reverse / output / data storage / zeroing upon sample break helps automate testing processes
2,000 point data memory – statistics, output, and optional date/time stamp
Password protection to prevent unauthorized changes
Pass/fail indicators, audio alerts, and outputs
Save/recall up to 500 profiles for test requirements (optional function)
Pull to a specific load or maintain load for a s specified period of time, as per UL 486A/B (optional function)
Date/time stamp for all saved data (optional function)
Optional Accessories
Ring terminal fixture (WT3002)
Multiple pin sizes are provided, from 1/8″ to 3/8″ [3.2 to 9.5 mm] dia.
Carrying case (WT3004-1)
Provides storage space for the WT3-201M tester, optional ring terminal fixture, power cord, USB cable, and accessories.
Machinable blank terminal fixture (WT3003)
For unique sample shapes and sizes.
MESUR™ gauge Plus software (15-1005)
tabulates and plots load vs. time or load vs. travel. Also calculates statistics, exports to Excel, and more.
Certificate of calibration (CERT) with data
CSC can provide an ISO7025 calibration cert with data with the purchase
Calibration kit (AC1049)
Complete set of brackets and hardware for calibration of a wire pull tester. Weights not available from Mark-10.
Optional Functions
Any of these optional functions may be purchased at time of order or may be enabled in the field at a later date though a simple activation process. A complete options package is also available, including all of the listed features at a discounted price. The tester is shipped in Demo Mode, during which time all available functions are enabled for 160 hours of operation.
Profiles (WF010)
Save and recall sets of test parameters, such as speed, pass/fail limits, unit of measurement, etc. Maximum of 500 profiles may be stored
Pull to Load (WF011)
The tester will stop when the specified load has been reached.
Load Holding (WF012)
The tester will stop and maintain a specified load for a specified period of time.
Date and Time Stamp (WF013)
A date and time stamp is applied to each saved data point.
Complete options package (WFCOMP)
Includes all optional functions listed above
Specifications:
Capacity x Resolution:
200 x 0.1 lbF | 3200 x 2 ozF | 100 x 0.05 kgF | 1,000 x 0.5 N | 1 x 0.0005 kN
Accuracy:
±0.2% of full scale
Wire Gauge Range:
AWG30 – AWG 3 [0.01 – 0.25 in (0.3 – 6.3 mm) dia.]
Sample Length Range:
Minimum 6.5 in [165 mm], excluding termination
Maximum Elongation:
1.7 in [43 mm]
Speed Range
Test speed – 0.4 – 12.0 in/min [10 – 300 mm/min]
Approach/Reverse Speed – 13.0 – 96.0 in/min [325 – 2,400 mm/min]
Speed Setting Accuracy:
±0.2%
Speed Variation with Load:
±0% stepper motor driven
Power:
Universal Input 80-240 VAC, 50/60 Hz
Sampling Rate:
7,000 Hz
Outputs:
USB / RS-232:
Configurable up to 115,200 baud
Mitutoyo
Serial BCD suitable for all Mitutoyo SPC-compatible devices
Analog
±1 VDC at capacity, ±0.25% of full scale
General Purpose
Three open drain outputs, one input
Set Points
Three open drain lines
Safe Overload:
Motor stops at 110% of full scale of the force sensor (display shows “OVER” at 110% and above)
Weight:
26.5 lb [12.0 kg]
Included Items:
Power cord
USB cable
certificate of calibration without data
CSC can supply an ISO17025 calibration cert with data with purchase
Environmental Requirements:
40 – 100°F, max. 96% humidity, non-condensating
Warranty:
3 years

Mark-10 G1046 Pneumatic Peel Test Grip
Capacity: 100 lbf
 Categories: Gripping Fixtures, Mark-10, Pneumatic Grips Tags: ASTM F88, G1046, Mark-10, Peel test grip, Pneumatic
Product Description & Resources
 Description 
Description
This fully enclosed, air-powered grip is ideal for seal strength testing of packaging, elongation testing of various materials, and other tensile testing requirements, per ASTM F88 / D1876. Serrated interlocking jaws effectively grip samples for up to 100 lbF (500 N) of force.
The grip features an industry-unique integrated open/close valve for quick sample engagement and disengagement, an added benefit for repetitive applications. An air connection kit, consisting of air tubing and fittings, is available as an option. Use a pair of these pneumatic grips with a force gauge and a test stand to create a complete testing system.
Features and Specifications
Capacity: 100 lbf @ 100 PSI
Integrated open/close valve
Fully enclosed design for safety
Weight: 0.6 lbf
Max Pressure: 125 PSI
Air input thread: #10-32 UNF
Includes:
#10-32 M/M stud with jam nuts
Optional Equipment
Air Connection Kit- AC1019
Maintenance kit- G1044

Mark-10 G1072 Opening Force Fixture
Capacity: 50 lbf
 Categories: Gripping Fixtures, Mark-10 Tags: G1072, Mark-10, Opening Force Fixture
Product Description & Resources
 Description 
Description
Used to determine the opening force of flat folded cartons along their score lines. Ideal for numerous applications in the packaging, food and beverage, medical device, consumer products, and many other industries.
Upper and lower fixtures are easily removable.
Use this fixture with a choice of test stand and force gauge to create a complete score bend testing system.
Features and Specifications:
Set of upper lower dies provided to accommodate various sized packaging materials
Fixtures are easily removable
Maximum force: 50 lbF (250 N)
Mounts directly to the following test stands (motorized test frames recommended)
F105, F305, F505, F755, F1505 Test Frames
 ESM303, ESM750, ESM1500, ES30, TSC1000, TSF Test Stands
ES10/ES20(when ordered with optional AC1060 mounting plate).
Weight:
Upper die:0.6 lb [0.03 kg]
Lowe die:0.10 lb [0.05 kg]
Included Items
Upper die includes a 5/16-18M to #10-32F thread adapter and #10-32 M/M stud with jam nuts.
Lower die includes mounting hardware for above listed test stands.
